courses.titleSv: Medicinsk genetik och cancer - molekylära mekanismer
courses.entryRequirements: 180 credits from a programme in biochemistry/chemistry, biology, biomedicine/medicine, biotechnology, cell/molecular biology, genetics, life science, medical sciences or a similar field of study. Also required are courses in biochemistry, cell biology, chemistry, genetics, and molecular biology/genetics totalling at least 30 credits. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

courses.titleEn: Molecular Techniques and Data Analysis in Precision Medicine I
courses.titleSv: Molekylära tekniker och dataanalys inom precisionsmedicin I
courses.entryRequirements: 180 credits, from an internationally recognised university. The degree must be in biochemistry/chemistry, biology, biomedicine/medicine, biotechnology, bioinformatics, cell-/molecular biology, genetics, life science, medical sciences, pharmacy, or a similar field of study. Also required are courses in human genetics, cell biology and molecular biology totaling 30 credits including knowledge corresponding to Medical genetics and cancer - molecular mechanisms (3MG022 or 3MG030).

courses.titleEn: Molecular Techniques and Data Analysis in Precision Medicine II
courses.titleSv: Molekylära tekniker och dataanalys inom precisionsmedicin II
courses.entryRequirements: 180 credits from educational programmes in biology, biomedicine/medicine, biotechnology, pharmacy, medical sciences, or a similar field of study. Also required are courses in cell biology, genetics, biochemistry and molecular biology. Also required is knowledge corresponding to Molecular Techniques and Data Analysis in Precision Medicine I 7.5 credits (3MG038), Introduction to machine learning and artificial intelligence for life sciences 7.5 credits (3FF041), Introduction to programming in R 7.5 credits (2ST133), and Biostatistics 7.5 credits (2ST134).

rules.labelEn: Students may either start the 45-credit Master's Project in Precision Medicine (3MG056) or take elective courses totalling 15 credits during that period.

rules.textSv: Examensarbete 30 hp, alternativt fortsättning på examensarbete 45 hp.
rules.labelEn: Either a 30-credit master's thesis or a continued 45-credit master's thesis may be taken.
